Look up study metadata from DOIs at build time

Source: R/study_info.R
fetch_study_metadata.Rd

Queries the free Crossref REST API once per distinct DOI and returns one row per study for generate_shiny(study_info = ...). Run this while authoring: generated apps read the stored result and never contact external services. DOIs that are missing, malformed, unknown to Crossref or unreachable are reported in the status column and a message; nothing is guessed or matched by title.

Usage

fetch_study_metadata(
  x,
  study = "study",
  doi = "doi",
  mailto = Sys.getenv("METAUI_MAILTO"),
  abstracts = c("open_licence", "exclude_nc", "none", "all"),
  openalex = TRUE,
  openalex_key = Sys.getenv("OPENALEX_API_KEY"),
  cache = NULL,
  pause = 0.2
)

Arguments

x

A dataset from prepare_data() with a url mapping, or a data frame with the columns named by study and doi.

study, doi

Column names used when x is not a prepared dataset.

mailto

Contact email sent to Crossref, as its etiquette requests, to use the "polite" pool. Defaults to the METAUI_MAILTO environment variable; leave it unset to query anonymously.

abstracts

"open_licence" (default), "exclude_nc", "none", or "all"; see Details.

openalex

Use OpenAlex for licences and abstracts that Crossref lacks.

openalex_key

Optional OpenAlex API key. Defaults to the OPENALEX_API_KEY environment variable.

cache

Optional CSV path. Rows already retrieved under the same abstract policy are reused and only the remaining DOIs are queried; the result is written back. Review or edit it like any other input file.

pause

Seconds between requests (both services allow several per second).

Value

A data frame with one row per study: study, doi, status (found, no_doi, invalid_doi, not_found, conflicting_dois or error), title, authors ("Family, Given; ..."), year, journal, volume, issue, pages, abstract, abstract_licence (a licence URL from Crossref or a licence code from OpenAlex), abstract_source, abstract_note, metadata_source, abstract_policy and retrieved.

Details

Bibliographic fields are always kept. Abstracts are not covered by Crossref's open metadata terms, so with the default abstracts = "open_licence" an abstract is kept only when the article is published under a Creative Commons licence (CC BY, with or without SA, ND or NC terms), CC0 or the Public Domain Mark. The licence is taken from the Crossref record (for the version of record, or an unspecified version, that has started by the lookup date) or, failing that, from the published-version locations that OpenAlex records. When Crossref has no abstract, OpenAlex's abstract is used. OpenAlex is asked only when Crossref leaves the abstract or its licence open.

NonCommercial (NC) licences permit use that is not primarily intended for commercial advantage or monetary compensation, which covers academic apps. If the app is used commercially, set abstracts = "exclude_nc" to drop them. abstracts = "all" keeps every abstract found: the app authors then take responsibility for the right to republish them, and the app says so.

Single-work lookups by DOI are free on both services and need no key. Crossref asks for a contact address: set METAUI_MAILTO (e.g. in ~/.Renviron). An OpenAlex key is optional and only raises the rate limit; create a free account at https://openalex.org, copy the key from Settings > API key and set OPENALEX_API_KEY. The key is sent as a request header and is not stored in the result or the app.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
raw <- data.frame(study = c("Smith 2020", "Lee 2021"), d = c(.2, .4), vi = c(.02, .03),
                  doi = c("10.1371/journal.pone.0287911", "10.1037/0033-2909.112.1.155"))
app_data <- prepare_data(raw, "study", "d", variance = "vi", url = "doi")
info <- fetch_study_metadata(app_data, cache = "study-metadata.csv")
generate_shiny(app_data, "Example", study_info = info, save_to_folder = "app")
} # }
